task.title: Select the same project options and directory as the build
task.problem: Default project options can select a different cached source tree from the one used by the build.
task.proposal: Forward repeatable -o KEY VALUE and -C DIR to Project.
acceptance: Both conditional source variants are selected correctly by the real CLI fixture.
Repeated option keys use the last value.
evidence: Delivered in merged PR #1 at cd94684843afee7a56eb148aa9de07b6b54c684e.
